note: E5 ground truth, kurated manually against the ACTUAL corpus (buissnes_agent/inputs/general_markdown, 13 documents). expected_sources are case-insensitive substrings matched against the chunk payload fields (source, title, markdown_path, url, markdown_url) - i.e. document base names. Curation rule: a document is relevant if it substantively covers the queried message/topic (verified by content scan; incidental one-off mentions excluded). Corpus facts that shaped the query set: pmt.009/pmt.002 are ABSENT (customer-side messages are pain.001/pain.002); camt.059/camt.028 are ABSENT (statements: camt.052/053/054, reconciliation: camt.029); 'Core Business Process 2' and 'onboarding' are ABSENT (replaced by pain.008 and the hybrid postal address topic). Code spellings vary in the corpus (pacs.002 with a dot vs pacs002) - queries use the dotted form, which appears everywhere the code appears.
